tool_args.rationale: The previous open-branch candidate fits were refuted, but the nine available rows provide substantially more information for the documented four-parameter barrier-modulated siphon than the earlier six-row fit. The new batch did not vary horizon, so it cannot establish temporal nonstationarity. This model numerically fits its parameters and avoids buying redundant same-horizon data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The existing probe has already supplied a sixth row; additional same-horizon branch data are less valuable than fitting the documented four-parameter barrier-modulated law to all nine available observations.
The previous trajectory batch varied inputs but retained H=0.6, so a further such batch is costly and does not directly resolve horizon dependence.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the cooperative Hill-2 inhibition law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It is a competing stationary four-parameter model, but the barrier-modulated siphon is a closer match to the shared siphon subtree and observed monotone-concave signature.
All observations remain same-horizon scalar data without the specified chaotic sign-oscillation signature or evidence that stationary mechanisms are untenable.
